title: A Simple Implicit Measure of the Effective Bid-Ask Spread in an Efficient Market
author: Richard Roll
finding: Under efficiency and stationarity assumptions, price-change serial covariance can imply effective spread. It is not a direct quoted-spread observation or proof of exploitable reversal.
Author, journal 39(4), 1127-1139 and DOI corroborated; metadata-only page. Formula transcription there is malformed; use publisher equation (1), not search snippet.
Current rules include RPI fills in last price and candles, while BBO and mark use organic orders. Current page is not historical-file applicability proof.
